create_even_pairs_task: create an EvenPairs task instance to check whether the number of 01s and 10s in binary strings is even
sample_batch_even_pairs: sample a batch of binary strings and their even/odd unequal pair labels using the EvenPairs task
get_input_size_even_pairs: get the input size property of an EvenPairs task instance for model configuration
get_output_size_even_pairs: get the output size property of an EvenPairs task instance for model configuration
test_even_pairs_task: test the EvenPairs task by sampling batches and verifying the odd unequal pair classification logic
